name: Jairus
bio: Jairus, a synagogue ruler, fell at Jesus's feet begging him to come heal his dying daughter. While Jesus was delayed healing a woman along the way, messengers came saying the girl had died, but Jesus told Jairus not to be afraid, only to believe. Taking only Peter, James, and John, Jesus went to Jairus's house, took the girl by the hand, and raised her from death, to the amazement of all present (Mark 5:21-43). The same episode is told without naming him in Matthew 9:18-26.
